metadata.title: Singular sets of conformal curves are discrete
metadata.abstract: We prove that the differential of a non-constant conformal curve between Euclidean spaces has full rank outside a discrete set. In particular, conformal curves are real-analytic outside a discrete set. We provide examples of entire associative and coassociative conformal curves with a non-empty singular set. We show that every non-constant Special Lagrangian conformal curve is a real-analytic conformal immersion. We also prove that a non-constant conformal curve has discrete fibers.
